notes.title: Backroom Beyond is going to be available in July. Add to your wishlist
notes.notes:
Backroom Beyond is a first-person game that mixes puzzles with single-player adventure in a dark, harrowing environment that makes the player question the protagonist's sanity. Based on the internet myth, Backroom Beyond goes further and makes the player wonder if that journey is about something more personal than anything else.

The narrative has two main points. Drawings tell part of the game's story on the walls. The drawings have no defined authorship, which gives them an extra degree of strangeness. The second point is the existence of The Guide, a being that instigates the players to think about their actions in real life.

The game basically has one objective throughout its 40-level journey: place the red box over the red button and open the door to the next level. It seems simple at first, but it's not. Each environment has its own logic. If the players feel frustrated because something went wrong in their strategy, they can press the “wake up again" button, which will return them to the beginning of the level.

Each scenario has a part of the story to be told, whether in the subway, in the snow, in the house, or in an actual backroom. Each place has its dose of tension and wonder.

The theme song chosen is Pérolas Irregulares (Irregular Pearls) by the band Terceiro Mundo Bom (Third Good World), whose clip has many similarities with the game's project.

[previewyoutube=pZKbzxEYNkw;full][/previewyoutube]

“I created this game because I could bring my contribution to the world of backrooms, which I was fascinated by. This myth has everything to do with the stories I tell about the existence of realities and universes that coexist and can collide. The story I set out to tell in Backroom Beyond is fragmented in a way that the player will need to interpret many of the elements. After all, who is The Guide? Who wrote on the walls? Has anyone been there before? Is it possible to leave?”, says Renan Barreto, creator of the game. “And being able to put in the game the song Pérolas Irregulares played by the band Terceiro Mundo Bom, which I'm a fan of is incredible. I could not be happier. The song and the video match very well with the proposal of the story and I would say that both complement each other”.

Backroom Beyond will be available on Steam on July 8th for Windows PC.


[b]Add to your wishlist.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2062820/Backroom_Beyond/

notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. 

We have listened to the community and decided to make a lot of changes to the game in order to make it better. Thank you all for playing and for the feedbacks (the positive and the negative ones). Both of us (two devs) took all the time we had in the past three days and worked hard to improve the experience. 

[b]Your save files from version 1.0 won't work properly in version 2.0. Please, start a new game.[/b]

So here is the list of changes: 

- Addition of a puzzle in the office
- Addition of puzzle in the garden
- Addition of puzzle in the guest room
- Addition of three maps in the game (1 floor, 2 floor and the attic)
- Textures were optmized
- Lighting was optimized
- Quiz section is not mandatory anymore
- A key was created to open the drawer in the former Quiz Section
- The podcast scene is not mandatory anymore
- A phone was added so the player can play the podcast
- Added points of light in the game
- The opening subtitles were updated
- The monster noise was lowered
- The character don't see through doors anymore
- No damage triggers in the "attic monster action"
- Bunker ceiling is now higher
- Doc 019 has the right page now.
- Monster post processing is now less darker
- No more flickering light in the bunker section
- Some fixing in the movements
- Now we have made available the secret ending as the main ending
- Minor sound fixes
- Subtitles background changed

Thank you all for playing. We hope to count with all of you to improve this game and the next ones we're creating. 

Stay safe everyone :)

notes.title: Survival horror game Hidden Shelter opening video disclosed
notes.notes:
The opening video of the horror game Hidden Shelter is released, which presents the characters of the game and what happens in the first moment of the story. 

[previewyoutube=VjKcudWiqBg;full][/previewyoutube]

Created by the White Vortex studio, Hidden Shelter is a suspense game which the premise is the search for a friend who mysteriously disappears in an accident near a house full of secrets.

“It is quite an experience to create a game. Making the Hidden Shelter has been incredible. We are learning a lot. We want to be able to tell a complex story through a simple premise. It's a challenge. We hope people can have fun. This video shows a little of who are these ordinary people that got trapped in this sinister situation ”, says Renan Barreto, creative director of the game and author of the story.

Hidden Shelter started its development in July 2020. In addition to Renan, the project has programmer Tiago Neri. “We share our tasks a lot and work on them whenever we have the time.We do everything, creating the art design, mapping, recording the lines, editing, programming and etc. It is a lot of work, but I believe that it’s necessary to invest everything of yourself in a project like this. I hope people have fun ”, says Tiago.

The game is being developed in Unreal Engine for PC and is scheduled for launch in January 2021. The game will have the languages ​​Portuguese and English.

Team:
Creative Director: Renan Barreto
Programmer: Tiago Neri

Voices: 
Guilherme Vieira as Charles.
André Bedran as Bernardo.
David Tavares as Diego.

notes.title: Hidden Shelter is the new game from White Vortex
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. 

This is Renan, gamedev from the White Vortex Studio. 

I'm here to say we're proud to present our newest game: [b]Hidden Shelter[/b]. 

[previewyoutube=iC0lXmc4CPU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] When I finished working on the [b]Last Battle: Order from Caos,[/b] I realized I had to do something different of an RPG. So, I took a script I've written to make a TV Series (Hello, Netflix. How are you?) and transformed it into a game. It was not an easy task, but it's been an incredible journey.

The game starts with a missing friend and the other two have to search for him and end up in a weird house. As a matter of fact, the number of the house is 421... It has a darker meaning to me than 666. We've decided to give this number to the house because 4 means death in Japanese and in English 2 (two / to) 1 (one / someone)... So, in this language mix it would mean something like "Death to someone".

The sinister things don't end there, of course. 

I want to hear what the community has to say about the game and what we've disclosed so far. As of now it's not much, it's true, however we're working to get deliver it to you as soon as possible. 

We're very excited to have everyone to step in a hidden place in the middle of nowhere. 

See you next time.

If you don't know, explore [b]Last Battle: Order from Caos[/b]. Available for Windows PC.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332540/Last_Battle_Order_from_Caos
